codes.meaning: A stream message of a type this receiver does not handle yet; in 1.1 every record, principal, group, membership and permission message.
No component on the site answers this job's kind for this source.
The other side did not answer in time: a component past the job's deadline, or Knovas when Link called it.
The job is no longer the caller's: its lease ended or it has an outcome already; the late part or result is discarded and counted.
The original could not be fetched: no component answered before the deadline, or the source did not answer.
The site or the source refused to hand out the original; the component's own code says why.
The document has no source reference, so its original cannot be located.
The item is not in the source, or not at the requested version.
The item changed in the source since the expected version; nothing was written.
The write's mode is not accepted; only proposal is, until autonomous agents exist.
The component's credential for the source lacks the rights a write needs (GitHub: contents and pull requests write).
Fetching originals is switched off for this source.
Writing back is switched off for this source.
The mapping's writes section does not name this fact.
The attribute is computed from other data and is never written.
The value breaks the source's own rule for the field (length, allowed values, date).
The fact is built by an expression that cannot be turned back into one field of the source.
The write names a mapping that the component's package does not hold.
The same change to this node was rejected before; a rejection is a tombstone.
Knovas Link has no certificate yet: it runs its control plane but claims no job and writes nothing to the tenant.
The Brain route is not on Knovas Link's relay allow-list.
